objective: Discover a universal low-parameter law that predicts held-out galaxy kinematics directly from audited photon, gas-tracer, angular-geometry, and calibration measurements, without an invisible-mass target or object-specific gravitational parameter.

inputs: angular radius and sky position relative to the galaxy center
calibrated surface-brightness profile or image pixels with PSF, sky, extinction, and photometric covariance
HI, H-alpha, or CO line-emission measurements with beam and line-spread provenance
audited angular geometry with uncertainty, retaining the image inputs used for inclination and position-angle inference
independently calibrated gas and stellar-population conversion factors with uncertainty
discovery_channel.prediction_target: held-out spectral-line centroid wavelength ratios or their reproducible line-of-sight Doppler-velocity representation with full covariance
discovery_channel.distance_exception: A physical-distance input is allowed only from a separately frozen non-redshift distance protocol with raw provenance and uncertainty.
discovery_channel.baryonic_conversion_rule: Brightness-to-stellar-mass and line-emission-to-gas-mass conversions are calibration nuisances, not direct observations; they must be globally frozen or hierarchically shared and may not be fitted separately to each galaxy's target kinematics.
allowed_formula_inputs: covariant fields and invariants already passed by the theory compiler
forbidden_formula_inputs: galaxy identity or catalog row identifier
dark-matter halo mass, concentration, radius, profile, or abundance-matching label
mass discrepancy inferred from the target rotation curve
lensing-derived mass, convergence, or acceleration map
per-galaxy acceleration scale or gravitational coupling

split_contract.stratification_inputs: measurement quality and directly measured morphology only; no target-derived discrepancy, halo fit, or redshift-derived environment
split_contract.sealed_test_rule: Test-galaxy measurements, identities, summary statistics, and residuals remain inaccessible until the theory hash, formula hash, universal constants, calibration policy, likelihood, and stopping rule are frozen.

scoring_contract.fit_term: joint held-out likelihood using the full measurement and calibration covariance
scoring_contract.complexity_term: description length or an equivalently preregistered symbolic-complexity penalty
scoring_contract.universality_term: one shared law and shared gravitational constants across every galaxy
required_baselines: Newtonian or weak-field GR prediction from the same audited baryonic inputs only
a preregistered empirical observable-to-observable relation used as a benchmark rather than ground truth
scoring_contract.selection_rule: Formula ranking uses training and validation galaxies only; no test or lensing result may influence search, hyperparameters, constants, or stopping.

allowed_measurements: audited time delays when directly measured
forbidden_targets: GR-derived convergence or mass map treated as truth
independent_lensing_falsification.same_law_rule: The frozen covariant action, universal constants, matter coupling, and baryonic calibration policy must predict lensing without any lensing-only parameter.

prohibited_truth_or_rescue: post-hoc baryonic recalibration chosen to rescue a failed gravity formula
opening_requirements: all required theory-side formal gates pass for the exact action hash
the observational evidence policy hash is frozen
the dataset manifest and raw-to-derived transformations pass an independent audit
the galaxy-level split manifest is hash-committed before any test target is opened
the likelihood, complexity penalty, calibration hierarchy, and stopping rule are preregistered
